togglePoliceLights.onDown: if not gameplay_policeControls then extensions.load('gameplay_policeControls') end if gameplay_policeControls then gameplay_policeControls.togglePoliceLights() end
togglePoliceLights.title: Police: Toggle Lights
togglePoliceLights.desc: Toggle police lightbar lights only (siren remains off unless enabled separately)

anprNextEntry.title: Police: ANPR Next Entry

anprPrevEntry.title: Police: ANPR Previous Entry

cyclePoliceSiren.title: Police: Cycle Siren
cyclePoliceSiren.desc: Single tap cycles police siren tones while lights are on. Double tap turns the siren off.
